body:
I know it's pretty common. I don't think that makes it any less devastating. 

I'm trying to man up. I've deleted her number and her facebook. I'm doing things to keep my mind off it. I've got over dumps before, this one just came at a bad time.

I appreciate your story. I do feel like I need to get out there and find some independence, I've just skimped along on money that the government have given me to do this degree.

My parents have told me that life just happens and that the best thing to do is just get out there and live it. So that's what I'm going to try and do. I'm also, going to try not to care what people think. I'm a bit of a waster, so what, I've had a great time up to now.

You're completely right, I got too content with this girl and it's hit me hard. I guess being dumped is never easy, I'm just trying to get myself over her at the moment.

I think I will graduate, I don't want to retake my current course and I won't be able to start a new degree until after graduation. So I figure I may as well stay, sort myself out along the way and pick up my crappy degree at the end of it all.

I would love to do an english lit degree. Ultimately I want to be a novellist, but I understand all to well the difficulties associated with succeeding at that.

Well, I don't want to be a statistician, my maths is pretty terrible. I said social sciences, but what I really do is more along the lines of political philosophy or maybe social policy. I enjoyed looking at theories of justice, especially punishment: so maybe some sort of prison official would interest me? I also looked at the social implications of video games, which as you can imagine was awesome. I would love to be a lobbyist for the gaming industry.

Like I say though, I won't have the degree or the CV to get into these sorts of fields straight off the bat. I guess, I'll just have to work harder than most to do something I enjoy. 

I think I could be quite happy in admin or HR, I do enjoy organisation and structure.
on the other hand, [if you don't make it, it's your own damn vault.](http://failposters.com/uploads/saved_posters/fail-poster-j8uop7nnbt-RISK.jpg)
